summary.plain: The VENUS detector at TRISTAN: a cylindrical drift chamber inside a superconducting solenoid, with a liquid-argon calorimeter in the end caps and other layers around it.
summary.technical: VENUS: superconducting solenoidal magnet, cylindrical drift chamber, liquid-argon electromagnetic endcap calorimeter.
